fixed_at_stage: After source/schema inspection; before computing RSSI distributions or distances
objective: Quantify observable operating-condition differences between the original fixed DES and public measured 2.4-GHz aerial IoT links, with explicit measurement compatibility.

empirical_dataset.include: Every signal.csv received-packet record with finite Rssi in the declared positive magnitude representation; no RSSI threshold or favorable-flight selection
empirical_dataset.grouping: Flight_Group is the primary campaign cluster; Run identifies altitude trials; Device and Transmitter_Id identify link orientations and transmitters
empirical_dataset.conversion: rssi_dbm = -Rssi. XBee reports an unsigned magnitude in negative-dBm units.
empirical_dataset.observation_process: RSSI is recorded for received packets, not continuously or for unreceived packets. No missing packet is assigned an RSSI.
empirical_dataset.time_rule: Keep native received-packet timestamps; do not interpolate to 100-ms model windows.

simulated_dataset.split: Original held-out 3000-series, all eight scenario families
simulated_dataset.probe: Native rssi_at at 20-ms points, t in [20000,90000) ms; factual process only
simulated_dataset.reason: Compare the raw modeled channel variable in dBm rather than confusing 100-ms five-probe averages with individual received-packet RSSI
simulated_dataset.calibration: None; original means, variance, blockage and channel parameters are fixed.

metrics.distance: Exact one-dimensional Wasserstein-1 in dB, integral of absolute difference between weighted empirical CDFs
metrics.primary_weighting: Equal weight per empirical Flight_Group and equal weight per simulated scenario, then equal weight per observation within its group
stratifications: Each of all nine Flight_Group values
Predefined physical-distance bins [0,75), [75,110), [110,175), [175,400), [400,infinity) metres; report every bin, including bins without a simulated scenario
metrics.strata_rule: Distance edges were fixed from the nominal DES distances and measurement context before outcome computation. A DES scenario belongs by its declared distance_m; a received field packet belongs by Real_Distance. These are descriptive shared-distance strata, not matched propagation experiments. Do not pool across radio/antenna conditions to claim equality.
metrics.uncertainty: Descriptive full-campaign summaries; no iid-packet confidence interval or hypothesis of protocol equivalence
metrics.posterior_distance: Not estimable: empirical measurement lacks most of the 25 simultaneous input features and simulator-defined four cause contributions.

interpretation: The distance quantifies marginal operating-condition difference, not goodness-of-fit for the same protocol, matched trajectory or censoring process.
No empirical posterior, calibration-error claim, action-success label, or deployment outcome will be synthesized from unavailable fields.
All source groups and all declared metrics are reported; no parameter is fitted and no data-driven source exclusion is allowed.
This public dataset supplies independent measured aerial-link context, not deployment of the proposed decision framework.
